blockers.wanted: a monotone 'weight' knob (centroid falls) and a 'busyness' knob over the whole range
blockers.tried: macro on cloth.weight (centroid claim -1) and on a gain scaling cloth.motion (density claim)
blockers.workaround: dropped the weight macro; kept busyness over a narrow gain range 0.25..1 (saturation above motion 1) and fixed the doc seed to 3; verify passes

blockers.wanted: a softness knob (swell fade-in slower) held to a claim
blockers.tried: claim attack 1 on the gate lowpass freq
blockers.workaround: left softness without a claim (verify only notes it is unclaimed); attack measures to the loudest burst (~354 ms, flat across the knob), not the swell

blockers.wanted: to know swell/attack and centroid vary strongly with doc seed (321 / 145 / 76 / 622 ms for seeds 1-4)
blockers.workaround: picked seed 3; variations 4 exported with very different swell timing (seed 4 peaks late, 622 ms)

wishlist: cloth with a smooth swell envelope input, or a way to cap the biggest burst so the peak does not dominate
a macro claim measuring swell attack (the 10 ms RMS headline) instead of sample-peak time
per-burst seed-stable shape so changing motion level does not reshuffle all bursts
what_worked: cloth node + expr gaussian bumps as motion gave 3 clear swells at first try (centroid 4-5 kHz, no pitch)
listen's swell/attack headline and onset/density lines were enough to judge the onset
verify macro sweeps caught the non-monotone weight/density knobs
